siteSubtitle: A community event for UX and design in Graz.

home.heading: Welcome to UX Day Graz 2027
home.introParagraph1: This event is for those who want to gain a better insight into the development of UX. There will be speakers who will address various topics and challenges within design. We will also talk about the value of a human designer over AI.
home.introParagraph2: Read more about the program by clicking the button below, and don't forget to register. This is an event you don't want to miss.

speakersPage.heading: Speakers
speakersPage.intro: Learn from designers, researchers, and developers sharing practical insights in UX design.

list.name: Alex Berger
about: Alex Berger is a UX designer and web developer from Graz, Austria. He enjoys creating simple and user-friendly websites.
He is passionate about technology, design, and improving digital experiences. In his free time, he enjoys photography, travelling, and learning new skills.

list.name: Jane Smith
about: Jane Smith is an accessibility designer from Vienna, Austria. She specializes in making digital products usable for people of all abilities.
She works closely with engineering teams to embed WCAG guidelines into everyday workflows. Outside of work, she enjoys hiking and architecture.

list.name: John Miller
about: John Miller is a UX researcher based in Graz, Austria. He helps organizations uncover real user needs through qualitative interviews and usability testing.
He believes strong research is the foundation of meaningful human-centered design. In his spare time, he enjoys cycling and reading.
